name: flight
description: Flight — Phase A vertical slice. Board a parked aircraft, spin up the engine, take off (rolling-bar minigame), fly over the map_world tile grid on a real-time posture tick loop (heading/throttle/altitude bands, fuel burn), and land (glideslope minigame). The aircraft is a first-class object that owns its occupant set — no runtime cabin zone; the cockpit HUD is synthesized and pushed each tick. Fuel-out is a lethal dead-stick crash that leaves a salvageable wreck. Piloting skill gates every takeoff/landing. Templates + airfields are content (aircraft_types table + zones.flags.airfield_id).
